changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetCrossReference') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetCrossReference]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [DataSource] [varchar](250) NULL, [Type] [varchar](50) NULL, [ExternalID] [varchar](250) NULL, [FieldHash] [varchar](50) NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionAssetCrossReference] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_api_ExecutionAssetCrossReference_Uid_DataSource_Type_ExternalID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_api_ExecutionAssetCrossReference_Uid_DataSource_Type_ExternalID] ON [api].[ExecutionAssetCrossReference] ( [uid] ASC, [DataSource] ASC, [Type] ASC, [ExternalID] ASC ) END
